# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Tokenising helpers (no imports: plain string operations only)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def clean(text):
    text = str(text).lower()
    for a, b in (("\u2019", "'"), ("\u2018", "'"), ("\u201c", '"'),
                 ("\u201d", '"'), ("\u2014", " , "), ("\u2013", " , "),
                 ("rs.", "rs ")):
        text = text.replace(a, b)
    out = []
    n = len(text)
    for i in range(n):
        ch = text[i]
        # digit grouping: 75,00,000 -> 7500000
        if ch == "," and 0 < i < n - 1 and text[i - 1].isdigit() and text[i + 1].isdigit():
            continue
        out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def tokenize(text):
    """Lower-case word tokens. '|' marks a sentence/clause boundary."""
    text = clean(text)
    chars = []
    n = len(text)
    for i in range(n):
        ch = text[i]
        if ch.isalnum() or ch == "'":
            if ch.isalpha() and chars and chars[-1][-1:].isdigit():
                chars.append(" ")  # 10yrs -> 10 yrs
            chars.append(ch)
        elif ch == "." and 0 < i < n - 1 and text[i - 1].isdigit() and text[i + 1].isdigit():
            chars.append(ch)  # decimal point
        elif ch in ".,;?!:":
            chars.append(" | ")
        elif ch == "\u20b9":
            chars.append(" \u20b9 ")
        else:
            chars.append(" ")
    toks = "".join(chars).split()
    merged = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(toks):
        if toks[i] == "self" and i + 1 < len(toks) and toks[i + 1] in ("employed", "employment"):
            merged.append("selfemployed")
            i += 2
        else:
            merged.append(toks[i])
            i += 1
    return merged


def negated(tokens, i, span=3):
    k = i - 1
    stop = max(-1, i - span - 1)
    while k > stop:
        if tokens[k] == "|":
            return False
        if tokens[k] in NEGATORS:
            return True
        k -= 1
    return False


def last_pos(tokens, phrases, check_neg=True):
    best = -1
    for ph in phrases:
        p = ph.split()
        m = len(p)
        for i in range(len(tokens) - m + 1):
            if tokens[i:i + m] == p:
                if check_neg and negated(tokens, i):
                    continue
                if i + m - 1 > best:
                    best = i + m - 1
    return best


def any_phrase(tokens, phrases):
    return last_pos(tokens, phrases, False) >= 0


def mask_phrase(tokens, phrase):
    p = phrase.split()
    m = len(p)
    for i in range(len(tokens) - m + 1):
        if tokens[i:i + m] == p:
            for k in range(i, i + m):
                tokens[k] = "_"


def split_clauses(tokens):
    clauses = []
    cur = []
    for t in tokens:
        if t == "|" or t in BOUNDARY_WORDS:
            if cur:
                clauses.append(cur)
            cur = []
        else:
            cur.append(t)
    if cur:
        clauses.append(cur)
    return clauses


def last_question(text):
    q = text.rfind("?")
    if q == -1:
        return text
    start = max(text.rfind(".", 0, q), text.rfind("?", 0, q), text.rfind("!", 0, q)) + 1
    return text[start:q]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Transcript -> role-labelled turns (customer vs agent)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def split_inline_labels(text):
    """Put a newline before a role label that appears mid-line."""
    low = text.lower()
    out = []
    for i in range(len(text)):
        if i > 0 and text[i - 1] in " \t":
            for role in ALL_ROLES:
                if low.startswith(role + ":", i):
                    out.append("\n")
                    break
        out.append(text[i])
    return "".join(out)


def parse_turns(transcript):
    turns = []
    text = split_inline_labels(transcript.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n"))
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        lower = stripped.lower()
        role = None
        content = stripped
        for r in ALL_ROLES:
            tag = r + ":"
            if lower.startswith(tag):
                role = "customer" if r in CUSTOMER_ROLES else "agent"
                content = stripped[len(tag):].strip()
                break
        if role is None:
            # continuation of the previous turn; text before the first label is ignored
            if turns:
                turns[-1]["text"] = (turns[-1]["text"] + " " + stripped).strip()
            continue
        if turns and turns[-1]["role"] == role:
            turns[-1]["text"] = (turns[-1]["text"] + " " + content).strip()
        else:
            turns.append({"role": role, "text": content})
    return turns


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Numbers, amounts and tenure
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def is_number_token(t):
    if not t or t.count(".") > 1:
        return False
    return t.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit()


def read_number(tokens, i):
    """Read a numeric or spoken number at tokens[i]. Returns (value, next_index, has_multiplier) or None."""
    n = len(tokens)
    t = tokens[i]
    if is_number_token(t):
        value = float(t)
        j = i + 1
    elif t in UNITS or t in TENS or t == "hundred":
        cur = 0
        consumed = 0
        k = i
        while k < n:
            w = tokens[k]
            if w in UNITS:
                cur += UNITS[w]
            elif w in TENS:
                cur += TENS[w]
            elif w == "hundred":
                cur = (cur if cur else 1) * 100
            elif (w == "and" and consumed > 0 and k + 1 < n
                  and (tokens[k + 1] in UNITS or tokens[k + 1] in TENS)):
                pass
            else:
                break
            consumed += 1
            k += 1
        value = float(cur)
        j = k
        if j + 1 < n and tokens[j] == "point" and tokens[j + 1] in UNITS and UNITS[tokens[j + 1]] < 10:
            value += UNITS[tokens[j + 1]] / 10.0
            j += 2
    elif t in ("a", "an") and i + 1 < n and tokens[i + 1] in MULTS:
        value = 1.0
        j = i + 1
    else:
        return None
    has_mult = False
    if j < n and tokens[j] in MULTS:
        value = value * MULTS[tokens[j]]
        j += 1
        has_mult = True
    return value, j, has_mult


def find_amounts(clause):
    """Money amounts in a clause: needs a lakh/crore/thousand unit, a currency word, or >= 1,00,000."""
    found = []
    n = len(clause)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        res = read_number(clause, i)
        if res is None:
            i += 1
            continue
        value, j, has_mult = res
        has_cur = (i > 0 and clause[i - 1] in CURRENCY) or (j < n and clause[j] in CURRENCY)
        if has_mult or has_cur or value >= 100000:
            found.append((value, i, j))
        i = max(j, i + 1)
    return found


def classify_amount(clause, s, e, ctx):
    """Decide whether an amount is the LOAN request or the PROPERTY VALUE (or unknown)."""
    nxt = []
    k = e
    while k < len(clause) and len(nxt) < 1:
        if clause[k] not in CURRENCY:
            nxt.append(clause[k])
        k += 1
    if nxt and nxt[0] in PROPERTY_NOUNS:
        return "value"          # "my 1.2 crore house"
    value_idx = [i for i, t in enumerate(clause) if t in VALUE_CUES]
    loan_idx = [i for i, t in enumerate(clause) if t in LOAN_CUES]
    if value_idx and not loan_idx:
        return "value"
    if loan_idx and not value_idx:
        return "loan"
    if value_idx and loan_idx:
        before = ([(i, "value") for i in value_idx if i < s]
                  + [(i, "loan") for i in loan_idx if i < s])
        if before:
            return max(before)[1]
        after = ([(i, "value") for i in value_idx] + [(i, "loan") for i in loan_idx])
        return min(after)[1]
    # No cue words in the clause: fall back on what the agent just asked.
    if any(t in VALUE_CUES for t in ctx):
        return "value"
    if any(t in LOAN_CUES for t in ctx):
        return "loan"
    return None


def tenure_from_clause(clause, tenure_ctx):
    if any(t in TENURE_EXCLUDE for t in clause):
        return None
    if not (tenure_ctx or any(t in TENURE_CUES for t in clause)):
        return None
    cue_end = -1
    for ph in CORRECTION_CUES:
        p = ph.split()
        m = len(p)
        for i in range(len(clause) - m + 1):
            if clause[i:i + m] == p:
                cue_end = max(cue_end, i + m - 1)
    cands = []
    n = len(clause)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        res = read_number(clause, i)
        if res is None:
            i += 1
            continue
        value, j, has_mult = res
        unit = clause[j] if j < n else ""
        if not has_mult and unit in YEAR_UNITS:
            cands.append((i, value))
        elif not has_mult and unit in MONTH_UNITS:
            cands.append((i, value / 12.0))
        elif (not has_mult and cue_end >= 0 and i > cue_end
              and 1 <= value <= 40 and unit not in CURRENCY):
            cands.append((i, value))   # "10 years... actually make that 12"
        i = max(j, i + 1)
    if not cands:
        return None
    return max(cands)[1]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Field detectors (each reads CUSTOMER tokens + the agent's last question)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def detect_property(tokens, ctx):
    asks_type = any_phrase(ctx, ["type of property", "kind of property",
                                 "property type", "what type", "what kind",
                                 "which type"])
    vocab = {
        "agricultural": ["agricultural", "agriculture", "agri", "farmland", "farm land"],
        "residential": ["residential"],
        "commercial": ["commercial"],
        "industrial": ["industrial"],
    }
    if asks_type:
        vocab["residential"] += ["house", "flat", "apartment", "villa", "bungalow", "home", "residence"]
        vocab["commercial"] += ["shop", "office", "showroom"]
        vocab["industrial"] += ["factory", "warehouse", "godown"]
    best = None
    best_pos = -1
    for kind in vocab:
        p = last_pos(tokens, vocab[kind])
        if p > best_pos:
            best = kind
            best_pos = p
    return best


def detect_ownership(tokens, ctx):
    own_ctx = any_phrase(ctx, ["owned", "ownership", "owner", "sole", "joint",
                               "jointly", "whose name", "your name"])
    mentions_prop = any_phrase(tokens, ["property", "house", "flat", "plot", "land",
                                        "apartment", "shop", "building", "home",
                                        "villa", "office"])
    own_words = any_phrase(tokens, ["own", "owned", "owner", "owners", "ownership"])
    sole = ["sole", "solely", "only owner", "single owner"]
    joint = ["joint", "jointly", "co owned", "co owner", "co owners", "coowned"]
    if own_ctx or mentions_prop:
        sole += ["i own", "my own", "owned by me", "in my name", "i am the owner",
                 "i'm the owner"]
    if own_ctx or own_words:
        sole += ["only me", "just me", "myself"]
        joint += ["with my wife", "with my husband", "with my brother",
                  "with my sister", "with my father", "with my mother",
                  "with my son", "with my daughter", "with my partner",
                  "our names", "both names", "my wife and i", "my husband and i",
                  "shared"]
    s = last_pos(tokens, sole)
    j = last_pos(tokens, joint)
    if s < 0 and j < 0:
        return None
    return "joint" if j > s else "sole"


def detect_documents(tokens, ctx):
    if any_phrase(tokens, DOC_HEDGES):
        return None                      # ambiguous: never record it
    docs_ctx = any_phrase(ctx, list(DOC_WORDS))
    neg = last_pos(tokens, COPY_WORDS)   # un-negated "photocopies" etc.
    pos = -1
    for i, t in enumerate(tokens):
        if t not in DOC_WORDS:
            continue
        s = i
        while s > 0 and (tokens[s - 1] in DOC_WORDS or tokens[s - 1] == "property"):
            s -= 1
        if negated(tokens, s, 4):
            neg = max(neg, i)
        else:
            pos = max(pos, i)
    if (pos >= 0 or docs_ctx) and any_phrase(tokens, DOC_NEG_PHRASES):
        neg = max(neg, 0)
    if neg >= 0 and neg >= pos:
        return False
    if pos >= 0:
        if docs_ctx or any_phrase(tokens, DOC_AVAIL):
            return True
        return None
    if docs_ctx:
        y = any_phrase(tokens, ["yes", "yeah", "yep", "yup", "haan", "han", "ji", "sure", "of course", "definitely", "absolutely"])
        n_ = any_phrase(tokens, ["no", "nope", "nahi", "nahin", "not"])
        if n_ and not y:
            return False
        if y and not n_:
            return True
    return None


def detect_occupation(tokens):
    self_pos = last_pos(tokens, ["selfemployed", "business", "businessman", "businesswoman",
                                 "shop", "shopkeeper", "trader", "freelancer", "freelance",
                                 "consultant", "contractor", "proprietor", "entrepreneur"])
    sal_pos = last_pos(tokens, ["salaried", "salary", "job", "employee", "employed",
                                "i work", "working in", "working for", "work in", "work for"])
    if self_pos < 0 and sal_pos < 0:
        return None
    return "self_employed" if self_pos > sal_pos else "salaried"


def detect_income(tokens, ctx):
    income_words = ["income", "salary", "earn", "earning", "earnings", "paid",
                    "payment", "payments", "receive", "received", "receiving",
                    "comes", "come", "credited", "credit", "profit", "profits",
                    "revenue", "wages", "wage", "deposited", "business", "shop"]
    income_ctx = any_phrase(ctx, ["income", "salary", "paid", "earn", "receive"])
    cue = income_ctx or any_phrase(tokens, income_words)
    qualifier = any_phrase(tokens, ["all", "only", "entirely", "mostly", "mainly",
                                    "fully", "completely", "everything"])
    cash_pos = last_pos(tokens, ["cash"]) if (cue or qualifier) else -1
    bank_pos = -1
    if cue:
        bank_pos = last_pos(tokens, ["bank", "banks", "account", "neft", "imps",
                                     "rtgs", "upi", "cheque", "deposited", "credited"])
    if cash_pos >= 0 and bank_pos >= 0:
        return None                      # mixed / unclear
    if cash_pos >= 0:
        return "cash"
    if bank_pos >= 0:
        return "bank"
    if cue and any_phrase(tokens, ["cash"]):
        return "bank"                    # "not in cash" with nothing else
    return None


def detect_transfer(tokens, ctx):
    masked = list(tokens)
    for p in NEG_LOAN:
        mask_phrase(masked, p)
    if any_phrase(masked, LOAN_PHRASES):
        return True
    if any_phrase(ctx, LOAN_QUESTION_PHRASES):
        y = any_phrase(masked, ["yes", "yeah", "yep", "haan", "han"])
        n_ = any_phrase(masked, ["no", "nope", "nahi", "nahin", "not"])
        if y and not n_:
            return True
    return False


def yes_no(tokens):
    masked = list(tokens)
    for p in OKAY_NEGATIVES:
        mask_phrase(masked, p)
    y = last_pos(masked, YES_PHRASES)                 # negation-aware
    n_ = last_pos(masked, NO_PHRASES, False)
    if y < 0 and n_ < 0:
        return None
    return "yes" if y > n_ else "no"


def is_cap_offer(agent_text):
    tokens = tokenize(agent_text)
    mentions = any_phrase(tokens, ["75 lakh", "75 lakhs", "75 lac", "75 lacs",
                                   "seventy five lakh", "seventy five lakhs",
                                   "seventy five lac", "seventy five lacs",
                                   "7500000", "75 l"])
    asks = any_phrase(tokens, ["proceed", "would you like", "do you want",
                               "are you okay", "are you ok", "is that okay",
                               "is that ok", "shall we", "go ahead",
                               "are you comfortable", "would that work",
                               "does that work", "interested in", "okay with",
                               "ok with"])
    return mentions and asks


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Whole-transcript evaluation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def evaluate(transcript):
    state = {
        "error": None, "property_type": None, "ownership": None,
        "documents": None, "occupation": None, "income": None,
        "market_value": None, "requested": None, "decision": None,
        "tenure": None, "transfer": False,
    }
    turns = parse_turns(transcript)
    if not turns:
        state["error"] = "TRANSCRIPT_PARSE_ERROR"
        return state
    if not any(t["role"] == "customer" for t in turns):
        state["error"] = "NO_CUSTOMER_UTTERANCES"
        return state

    prev_agent = ""
    cap_open = False
    for turn in turns:
        if turn["role"] == "agent":
            prev_agent = turn["text"]
            # A cap offer only counts AFTER the customer asked for more than the limit.
            cap_open = (state["requested"] is not None
                        and state["requested"] > LIMIT
                        and is_cap_offer(prev_agent))
            continue

        # ---- customer turn: only the customer's own words are analysed ----
        tokens = tokenize(turn["text"])
        ctx = tokenize(last_question(prev_agent))

        if detect_transfer(tokens, ctx):
            state["transfer"] = True

        p = detect_property(tokens, ctx)
        if p:
            state["property_type"] = p
        o = detect_ownership(tokens, ctx)
        if o:
            state["ownership"] = o
        d = detect_documents(tokens, ctx)
        if d is not None:
            state["documents"] = d
        occ = detect_occupation(tokens)
        if occ:
            state["occupation"] = occ
        inc = detect_income(tokens, ctx)
        if inc:
            state["income"] = inc

        loan_vals = []
        tenure_ctx = any_phrase(ctx, ["tenure", "tenor", "repay", "repayment",
                                      "how many years", "how long", "period",
                                      "duration", "term"])
        for clause in split_clauses(tokens):
            for value, s, e in find_amounts(clause):
                kind = classify_amount(clause, s, e, ctx)
                if kind == "loan":
                    loan_vals.append(value)
                elif kind == "value":
                    state["market_value"] = value
            t = tenure_from_clause(clause, tenure_ctx)
            if t is not None:
                state["tenure"] = t
        new_loan = loan_vals[-1] if loan_vals else None

        if cap_open:
            answer = yes_no(tokens)
            if answer == "no":
                if new_loan is not None and new_loan < LIMIT:
                    state["requested"] = new_loan
                    state["decision"] = None
                else:
                    state["decision"] = "rejected"
                    if new_loan is not None:
                        state["requested"] = new_loan
            elif answer == "yes":
                if new_loan is not None and new_loan != LIMIT:
                    state["requested"] = new_loan
                    state["decision"] = None
                else:
                    state["decision"] = "accepted"
            elif new_loan is not None:
                state["requested"] = new_loan
                state["decision"] = None
        elif new_loan is not None:
            state["requested"] = new_loan
            state["decision"] = None
        cap_open = False
    return state


def dig(obj, *path):
    cur = obj
    for key in path:
        if isinstance(cur, dict) and key in cur:
            cur = cur[key]
        else:
            return None
    return cur


def transcript_to_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, list):
        lines = []
        for entry in value:
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                role = str(entry.get("role", "")).lower()
                content = entry.get("content") or entry.get("text") or entry.get("message") or ""
                label = "Agent" if role in AGENT_ROLES else "User"
                lines.append(label + ": " + str(content))
            else:
                lines.append(str(entry))
        return "\n".join(lines)
    return str(value)


def find_transcript(data):
    candidates = [
        data.get("transcript"), data.get("transcrip"),
        dig(data, "call", "transcript"), dig(data, "body", "call", "transcript"),
        data.get("transcript_object"), dig(data, "call", "transcript_object"),
        dig(data, "body", "call", "transcript_object"),
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if c:
            return transcript_to_text(c)
    return ""


ALL_ITEMS = ["property_type", "ownership_status", "documents_available",
             "loan_amount", "occupation_and_income_mode", "market_value", "tenure"]

for item in items:
    data = item.get("json", {})
    transcript = find_transcript(data)
    st = evaluate(transcript) if transcript.strip() else {"error": "EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT"}

    flags = []
    missing_items = []

    if st["error"]:
        flags.append(st["error"])
        missing_items = list(ALL_ITEMS)
        status = "INCOMPLETE"
    else:
        requested = st["requested"]
        above = requested is not None and requested > LIMIT
        decision = st["decision"]

        if st["property_type"] == "agricultural":
            flags.append("POSSIBLE_AGRICULTURAL_PROPERTY")
        if st["income"] == "cash":
            flags.append("POSSIBLE_CASH_INCOME")
        if st["documents"] is False:
            flags.append("POSSIBLE_DOCUMENTS_UNAVAILABLE")
        if st["transfer"]:
            flags.append("POSSIBLE_EXISTING_LOAN_OR_EMI_TRANSFER")
        if above and decision != "accepted":
            flags.append("LOAN_AMOUNT_ABOVE_LIMIT")
        tenure = st["tenure"]
        if tenure is not None and not (3 <= tenure <= 15):
            flags.append("TENURE_OUT_OF_RANGE")

        if st["property_type"] is None:
            missing_items.append("property_type")
        if st["ownership"] is None:
            missing_items.append("ownership_status")
        if st["documents"] is None:
            missing_items.append("documents_available")
        if requested is None:
            missing_items.append("loan_amount")
        if st["occupation"] is None or st["income"] is None:
            missing_items.append("occupation_and_income_mode")
        if st["market_value"] is None:
            missing_items.append("market_value")
        if tenure is None:
            missing_items.append("tenure")

        disqualifying = ["POSSIBLE_AGRICULTURAL_PROPERTY", "POSSIBLE_CASH_INCOME",
                         "POSSIBLE_DOCUMENTS_UNAVAILABLE", "TENURE_OUT_OF_RANGE"]
        if st["transfer"]:
            status = "TRANSFER_SPECIALIST_REQUIRED"
        elif any(f in flags for f in disqualifying):
            status = "DISQUALIFIED"
        elif above and decision == "rejected":
            status = "CUSTOMER_DECLINED"
        elif above and decision is None:
            status = "OFFER_MAXIMUM_75_LAKH"
        elif missing_items:
            status = "INCOMPLETE"
        else:
            status = "REVIEW_REQUIRED"

    result = dict(data)
    if result.get("call_id") is None:
        result["call_id"] = dig(data, "call", "call_id") or dig(data, "body", "call", "call_id") or ""
    if result.get("transcript") is None:
        result["transcript"] = transcript
    if result.get("call_status") is None:
        result["call_status"] = dig(data, "call", "call_status") or ""
    if result.get("call_summary") is None:
        result["call_summary"] = (dig(data, "call", "call_analysis", "call_summary") or "")
    result["scenario"] = data.get("scenario") or "manual_test"
    result["evaluation_status"] = status
    result["missing_items"] = ", ".join(missing_items)
    result["detected_flags"] = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(flags))
    result["prompt_version"] = data.get("prompt_version") or "v3"
    result["evaluated_at"] = data.get("evaluated_at", "")

    results.append({"json": result})

return results
